raf_callback_cadence_hz.measurement_method: requestAnimationFrame timestamp delta over active window (Linux Chromium headless)

cdp_heap_memory.measurement_method: Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) Performance.getMetrics after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage

production_security_probe.script_src_unsafe_inline_reason: Inline script blocks (auth sheet/routing helpers lines 29-79 in index.html) and inline DOM event attributes (onclick handlers) require 'unsafe-inline' until refactored or nonced.
production_security_probe.dual_token_emission_reason: POST /api/auth/login sets an HttpOnly transify_session cookie for web browsers AND emits token in JSON response body for native Android client (MainActivity.kt) compatibility.
production_security_probe.native_bridge_ipc_security: NOT APPLICABLE / NOT TESTED (No Electron, Tauri, or WebView2 host IPC bridge is implemented in this repository)
